title: CREDITS AND POINTS ARE ONE THING
why: His order of 2026-10-11 evening: in arcade mode, credits and points should be synonymous. The arcade score was a points number next to a world priced in credits, and a valuable scored only a tenth of its price. Now a valuable you loot in the arcade scores its full credit value, into the score and into the haul pot. Every arcade score number reads as credits with a dollar sign: the score at the top with YOU and P2, the kill popups, the pickup tags, the EXTRACTED banner, the teammate extraction callout, the attract board, the team strip, the RUN OVER card and NEW HIGH SCORE. Kills keep their values (a crawler is 50, the Overseer 2,000), now read as credits. Your own credits are still never touched by the arcade, and normal raids are unchanged.
now: In the arcade the score is credits: loot scores its full value and every score reads in dollars.
